lines: Good afternoon, this is the customs department at the airport
A package sent using your identity has been caught with banned substances
Please connect on a Skype video call with the police inspector right away
Hello?
Keep the camera switched on and do not inform anybody at home, you are under arrest digitally
Namaste, main narcotics department se officer bol raha hoon
Aapke naam se gaye parcel mein ganja aur fake passport mila hai
Jo account bhej raha hoon usme sab paisa daal do, jaanch ke baad lautaya jayega
मैं साइबर क्राइम पुलिस से बोल रहा हूँ, आपके नाम के पार्सल के बारे में
आपके आधार कार्ड से एक खाता खुला है जिसमें करोड़ों का गैरकानूनी लेन-देन हुआ
स्काइप पर वीडियो कॉल जोड़िए, थानेदार साहब आपसे पूछताछ करेंगे
Hi, calling from your bank about the pending know your customer update
If it is not done within an hour, your account gets suspended today
Install the remote support app I am texting you and open it
Read me the code that just arrived on your phone
Sir bank se bol raha hoon, KYC update karna hai
Aapke mobile pe jo OTP aaya hai woh batao
Transaction fail hua, ek aur OTP aayega woh bhi bolo
We are offering a home based job, earn money by liking videos on your phone
Congratulations, a 200 rupees reward has been credited to you for the tasks
Next level tasks need a prepayment, add money on the task portal first
Your balance went negative, you have to put more money to get it back
घर से पार्ट टाइम काम कीजिए, होटल को रेटिंग देकर पैसे कमाइए
टेलीग्राम ग्रुप में आइए, पहले कुछ पैसे जमा करने होंगे
पैसे निकालने के लिए पहले टैक्स जमा कीजिए, तभी पैसे मिलेंगे
I want your sofa, I will send the money before I come, I am in the army
Scan the code I have sent you on WhatsApp to get the amount
Enter your PIN, then the money will be in your account
Maine aapko QR code bheja hai, usko scan karo
PIN daalo tab paisa milega
Arre galti se zyada paisa chala gaya, extra wapas bhejo
They said a parcel in my name had drugs and a case is filed against me
Now they want me to send all my savings to an RBI account so they can check it
Bank wala bol raha tha KYC expire ho gaya, account band ho jayega
Ab mujhse phone pe aaya OTP maang raha hai
वीडियो लाइक करने का पार्ट टाइम काम बताया था
अब कह रहे हैं पैसे निकालने के लिए पहले फीस भरो
